items.title: What's on This Page
items.why:
1. Buzz's forehead stripes, painted out (Eras art).
2. The built "Who's registering?" setup screens, which you asked to see before publishing.
3. Two fixes for the name tiles on sideways phones and with large text.
4. Whether to publish 2.27.0.

Nothing is published yet.

items.title: Buzz Without Forehead Stripes
items.why: ChatGPT kept drawing stripes, even as a Russian Blue. I painted them out on all 11 pictures where his forehead shows: grey fur pixels clearly darker than the fur around them are filled with the lighter fur next to them. His outlines, eyebrow marks, eyes and ears are untouched. The striped originals are kept.

items.title: The Built First Screen
items.why: Built as you picked: name tiles, Somebody Else below, the waving mascot and the links kept. Tapping a name highlights it; the screen keeps its look until Continue (the person's own look starts on the next screen).

items.title: Lennon's Grown-up Screen
items.why: After tapping Lennon, this screen asks a grown-up to answer his questions. He gets a starter plan with no equipment and the Dragon Ball look until his kid mode is built.

items.title: Somebody Else and the Equipment Question
items.why: Somebody Else still gets "What brings you here?". Every path now asks what equipment they have; for paths that didn't ask before (like Eat better), it's its own short screen.

now.caption: Equipment, on the Eat better path

items.title: Sideways Phone
items.why: On a phone turned sideways, you only see the tops of the tiles until you scroll (0 of 4 tiles fully visible).

options.label: One row on short screens
options.desc: When the screen is short, the mascot hides and the 4 tiles sit in one row with smaller badges. All 4 fully visible.

items.title: Small Phone With Large Text
items.why: On a small phone with larger text, the second row of tiles is cut off by the fade (2 of 4 fully visible).

options.label: Smaller badges when space is tight
options.desc: Smaller badges and mascot on narrow or short screens. All 4 fully visible.

items.title: Publish 2.27.0?
items.why:
Checks: the new setup check passes 82 of 82; every earlier check passes (pick29 31, keyboard 21, water 10, sync 16, history 18, worker 37, scan button 49, theme colours, balanced wrapping on all 352 screens). One themes check on the Backup History list is being rerun after a slow-loading result; I publish only if it passes. The full audit's only new findings are the name-tile ones on this page.

IMPORTANT: when 2.27.0 opens on each phone, it erases everything on that phone (profiles, logs, settings) and starts at "Who's registering?", as you chose. It can't be undone. The cloud has no accounts, so there's nothing to erase there.

If you pick tile fixes above, I build them, check them, then publish.
